events.title: Diffie and Hellman publish foundational public-key cryptography work

research.summary: Diffie and Hellman published New Directions in Cryptography, introducing the public-key cryptography framework and digital-signature concept to the open literature.
research.significance: Foundational cryptographic infrastructure later used by digital-cash systems and cryptocurrencies.
